What is the average amount of interest (in thousands) per year that the factory had to pay during the given period?
solution:

**Concept Used:**

Average = Total Sum of values ÷ Number of values

**Calculation:**

⇒ Total interest of all the years = 13.4 + 23.5 + 31.6 + 26.4 + 39.4

⇒ Total interest of all the years = 134.3

⇒ Total number of years = 5

⇒ Total average amount of interest per year = (134.3)/(5)=26.86

**Therefore, the average amount of interest per year that the company had to pay during the given period is 26.86**
